overall_reason: The one chart on the page, 'Cycle time by agent' in the planning product mock, is a strip plot by month with no value axis and no agent breakdown, so its title promises a comparison the marks do not show.

score.reason: T-CHART-TEXT-MATCH and T-HONEST-SCALE fail on the one product-mock chart (DVZ-005, DVZ-010); the page otherwise has no decorative charts or stat confetti.

findings.where: 'Planning and monitoring' product mock, div.fFDhtq_plot > svg.fFDhtq_dots (aria-hidden), 1440, contact sheet #1, tiles/1440-04.png and 1440-05.png
findings.evidence: The panel is titled 'Cycle time by agent'. The svg (825 by 400px) draws about 438 dots (markers 438) in four columns under 'Oct 2025', 'Nov 2025', 'Dec 2025' and a faded fourth month, all in one teal (palette: teal family only). Nothing separates one agent from another, and the value axis has no tick labels or unit (axes: none).
findings.before: A one-colour strip plot by month under a title that promises a split by agent, with no cycle-time scale.
findings.after: Either retitle it 'Cycle time per issue, by month' and add a value axis in days, or split the dots by agent with a direct label at the end of each group.
findings.why: A product picture that shows a chart is still read as a chart; this one cannot answer its own title, and without a scale the spread of the dots means nothing. Sample data inside the mock is fine (conflict C22).

findings.evidence: The plot shows no unit, no value ticks and no reference line for a target or median; the orange stepped lines behind the dots are not labelled and the in-plot words 'Public Beta' and 'Alpha' (direct_labels) belong to the roadmap beside it.
findings.before: A plot with month labels only.
findings.after: Add a median line labelled with its value in days and a y-axis with two or three rounded ticks.
findings.why: Cycle time is a duration; with no unit the reader cannot tell whether a dot is hours or weeks.

strengths: The roadmap mock beside the plot uses a real date axis (MAR, APR with weekly ticks) with milestones placed on it and labelled directly ('Core screens', 'Polish').
The page makes no stat-band claims and uses no decorative chart: the one figure belongs to a product picture.
